Six-site strengthening proves global ordinary cap infeasible for one actual deviation despite a low-deviator exact NE. Initial greedy incidence ordering: each customer starts at a maximum-final-multiplicity accessible occupied site. New output-recognizable polynomial factor-two theorems for all-distinct greedy layouts and multiplicity-class range-certified layouts; the latter subsumes light-overlap and all-heavy-overlap conditions. Two exact integer examples refute arbitrary repair and heaviest-first repair while retaining an alternative good NE at the same greedy layout. New bit-polynomial factor-two construction for greedy occupied-overlap components of constant multiplicity or size at most two, including unequal multiplicities outside the range certificate. Two exact fixed-layout selection obstructions: unique bad lexmax customer assignment and unique bad global weighted-customer-potential minimizer. Arbitrary-size all-or-one mixed-multiplicity occupied components admit descending-weight minimum-normalized-load list assignment and bit-polynomial factor-two completion. A six-client strict-greedy three-site chain forces every downward-only client repair path to require an upward return. Nested-anchor partial overlaps with weight-ordered expanding eligible sets now admit restricted list assignment and full polynomial factor two; reversing sets refutes the unrestricted list rule only. Universal singleton reset from the original greedy assignment completes any supplied box-constrained on-path NE in polynomial time. A lower-bounded integral convex-cost flow constructs that box NE for arbitrary partial overlaps when all light multi-option clients have equal weight. A two-unequal-light-client parametric obstruction to lower-box-only weighted-potential minimization, with a box NE on the same layout. New bit-polynomial full factor-two construction for anchored light-star components with arbitrary unequal light weights and frozen heavy cross-component clients. A reset of original greedy customer pools also completes any exact on-path NE with every facility earning at least gamma when original source pools admit checked q-1 deletion packing. Two deterministic LPT checks give a polynomial recognizable class whose constructed pure NE can violate the site upper box. Directed opening-order light paths with per-edge equal but cross-edge unequal weights admit a one-move-per-client boxed NE. Type compression gives an FPT fixed-greedy-occupancy box-NE decision in (occupied sites, distinct multi-option weights), an FPT frozen-heavy light-component subclass, and an unconditional XP factor-two constructor in total catalog size and distinct weights. Every full-box potential minimizer on an opening-directed three-site light chain is an exact customer NE even with arbitrary unequal light weights within each edge, giving conditional box existence and existential full factor two. A four-site three-light-client converging path D->B->A<-C with checked multiplicities and a tight A lower box has a bounded-step boxed-NE constructor and complete polynomial factor-two continuation. Opening-directed light overlap graphs with no directed path longer than two edges have a full-box exact site-uniform client NE at every global constrained-potential minimum, even with arbitrary branching, merging and unequal weights; the three-site chain follows as a special case. A stronger four-move constructor handles every one-light-client-per-edge converging D->B->A<-C path without tightness at A or equality of q_A and q_C; the earlier seven-step lemma is retained as a narrow independent proof. A strict four-site multi-parent, unequal-within-edge height-two input separates the existence theorem from the existing polynomial STAR, PATH and DOUBLE-LPT sufficient classes; its full-box potential minimum is explicitly enumerated. A strict nine-facility example has untight A and unequal A/C multiplicities and executes all four moves, showing the strengthened bound is attained. Bounded individual-client incidence degree and treewidth give a bit-polynomial exact boxed-NE CSP selector; intersecting this class with shallow opening-directed two-option light graphs gives a complete polynomial factor-two continuation. Degree counts individual clients on both sides; universal boxed feasibility is supplied separately by the 2026-10-07 global-progress theorem. The local-weight site-primal DP adds exact boxed-NE selection for fixed width and per-site distinct light-weight count; the late-center inward-star maximum-key queue supplies a factor-two constructor with unbounded center diversity. The all-or-one condition excludes mixed-q partial-overlap components with three or more sites. The downward-only trap is a method obstruction with an exact NE after one return, not a factor-two lower bound. The new SC-K-BOX-STRUCTURED-POLY-2 supplies total polynomial construction on their fixed-parameter classes without shallow-depth restrictions; general bit-polynomial time remains open. Boxed-potential hardness is not hardness of finding any boxed NE or a factor-two certificate.
